title: Sulfur–boron mud autotrophic denitrification for simultaneous nitrate and phosphate removal from wastewater: batch, column, and pilot-scale experiments
content:
Environ. Sci.: Water Res. Technol., 2025, 11,2712-2724
DOI: 10.1039/D5EW00446B, Paper
Lixin Shao, Dajing Liu, Dexi Wang, Hang Zhao, Xibo Zhao, Lihua Fan
The SBMAD system can efficiently remove NO3−–N and PO43−–P simultaneously. Fe2+ released from boron mud enhanced the NO3−–N and PO43−–P removal effects of SAD. Contribution rates of S and Fe2+ to the NO3−–N removal efficiency were 93.10% and 6.90%.
